title: Qwen Long Context 256K — Single GPU
description: OpenAI-compatible serverless endpoint for hybrid Qwen models (Qwen3.5-9B, Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, Qwen3.6-27B) with 128K–256K context on a single 24 GB or 48 GB GPU. Built on llama.cpp with pinned GGUF weights and ready-made presets; if a context does not fit, the worker steps it down automatically instead of crashing. Apache-2.0 weights, no HF token needed.

config.gpuIds: ADA_24,AMPERE_24,ADA_48_PRO,AMPERE_48,-NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition MIG 1g.24gb,-NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition MIG 2g.48gb,-NVIDIA B200,-NVIDIA B300 SXM6 AC

input.name: Preset
input.description: Model + context + KV cache bundle. 'auto' picks the 9B 256K preset on <40 GB GPUs and the 35B-A3B 256K preset on 48 GB GPUs. 'custom' uses MODEL_REPO/MODEL_FILE/MODEL_REVISION.

options.label: 48 GB · Qwen3.6-35B-A3B Q8_0 · 256K · KV q8_0 (not benchmarked)

input.name: Context length
input.description: Target context in tokens (e.g. 131072). Empty = preset value. 'auto' = largest that fits (llama.cpp --fit). Capped at the model's 262144. If it does not fit, the worker steps down automatically.

input.name: Minimum context
input.description: Auto-fit never goes below this. If even this does not fit, the worker returns OOM_MIN_CONTEXT instead of looping.

input.name: KV cache precision
input.description: Precision of the attention-layer cache. Empty = preset value. f16 = best quality; q8_0 = half the memory, near-lossless; q4_0 = quarter memory, noticeably less precise at long range. The linear-attention state is always FP32.

input.name: Parallel requests per worker
input.description: Number of llama.cpp slots. The context is shared between slots, so 2 slots on a 256K preset give each request about 128K.

input.name: Thinking mode by default
input.description: Qwen reasoning before answering. Slower and uses more tokens; can be overridden per request with chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking.

input.name: Default max_tokens
input.description: Used when a request does not set max_tokens.

input.name: Custom GGUF repo
input.description: Only for PRESET=custom. Hugging Face repo with GGUF files, e.g. unsloth/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-GGUF.

input.name: Custom GGUF file
input.description: Only for PRESET=custom. One .gguf file name inside the repo (multi-part files: give the first part).

input.name: Custom revision
input.description: Only for PRESET=custom. Commit SHA to pin. 'main' works but is not reproducible.

input.name: Model load timeout (s)
input.description: Max time for download + load on a cold start before the worker reports an error.

input.name: Hugging Face token
input.description: Not needed for the built-in presets. Only for private/gated custom GGUF repos. Use a Runpod secret.
